## @aegis-skills/themis-gateway 0.1.0 - first release

The governed MCP client of Themis: tool allow-lists, read/write/execute classification, call budgets, secret redaction, untrusted-output wrapping and human approval requests. It depends on `@aegis-skills/themis-core` `^0.1.0`.

This is an **internal library, pre-1.0**. Its API is not a public contract and can change in any 0.x release, and Themis itself is still in development and not released. The gateway reduces risk but is not a security boundary on its own. You normally do not need to install it. Pin an exact version if you do.

Install: `npm install @aegis-skills/themis-gateway` (Node.js 24 or later). Licence: Apache-2.0 OR MIT.

This release is not marked Latest on GitHub: the Latest release is reserved for `aegis-skills`, because Gemini CLI reads its extension archives from it.
